v_n_text: The vehicle shall quickly recalculate its trajectory if an obstacle is detected in its path.
v_n1_text: The vehicle shall recalculate its trajectory within 500 milliseconds if an obstacle is detected within 10 meters of its path.
human_historical_rationale: Clarified latency constraint and obstacle proximity threshold in v3.0.

v_n_text: The system shall ingest sensor readings and shall also transmit telemetry to ground control if applicable.
v_n1_text: The system shall ingest sensor readings at a minimum sampling rate of 50 Hz.
human_historical_rationale: Separated telemetry transmission into companion requirement REQ-SMIRK-03 to enforce singularity.

v_n_text: When a Vital Anomaly occurs, the system shall alert the supervisor within 2 seconds.
v_n1_text: When a Vital Anomaly occurs, the system shall alert the supervisor within 2 seconds.
human_historical_rationale: Unchanged in later version because 'Vital Anomaly' was already fully defined in glossary.

v_n_text: The system shall provide an intuitive dashboard displaying current train speed and brake status.
v_n1_text: The system shall display current train speed and brake status on the Driver Console adhering to the UIC 612 standard.
human_historical_rationale: Replaced vague subjective term 'intuitive' with explicit UIC 612 interface specification.
